dimensions.name: Accuracy
dimensions.description: Correct fundamentals are the first thing a technical interviewer checks.

levels.1: Major errors or no real answer.
levels.5: Correct and precise, including the important edge cases.

dimensions.name: Depth
dimensions.description: Going past the definition to the how and the why separates understanding from memorising.

levels.3: Explains how it works at a basic level.
levels.5: Explains why it works and discusses trade-offs.

dimensions.name: Applied examples
dimensions.description: Connecting a concept to real use shows you can apply it at work.

levels.5: A concrete example, ideally from the candidate's own project.

dimensions.name: Technical communication
dimensions.description: Teammates must be able to follow your explanation.

levels.5: Builds the explanation step by step, using terms correctly.
